text:
marta: Heads up — onboarding Zephyr-7B into the eval harness is spiking the regression alert for `response_coherence`. CI shows weird normalization errors, not obvious model regressions.
ryan: can you paste the failing log?
marta: sure — this started after we added the new chat_template that includes a "system" prefix with trailing newline. suspect normalization step strips sentinels differently.
ryan: pls tag @anika for tokenizer/normalization checks.
manual paste of config:```chat_template: [ {role: system, content: "You are an assistant.\n"}, {role: user, content: "{{prompt}}"} ]```
anika: odd — trailing newline in system content can create an empty last turn after our collate step. that then goes into metric normalizer which divides by token counts.
sam: i saw the CI error:```ERROR: metric_pipeline: normalization failed: division by zero for response_coherence (ref_tokens=0)```
devon: that division by zero path should have been safeguarded — our CI should have caught and converted to NaN not crash the metric aggregator. looks like a regression in the metric middleware from the refactor last month.
marta: eval-ci-bot posted: "eval-runner-e2e | job failed | 1 test flaky" and linked to logs https://ci.internal/redwood/zephyr/onboard/22399
ryan: short-term: revert chat_template newline or strip empty turns before metric step. long-term: add a guard in metric normalizer and a unit test for zero-reference case.
anika: i'll open a small PR to strip empty messages in collate (WIP). also will add tokenizer check for zero-length references (edge case: system-only prompts).
sam: i'll open a follow-up PR to ensure metric normalizer returns NaN and doesn't count toward regression alerts.
devon: created tracking issue: #INF-1242 "metric normalizer: divide-by-zero on empty ref tokens". tagging for postmortem if alerts fired.
marta: thanks — moving Zephyr bring-up to blocked until patches land, but will keep running local evals with the newline removed from template. :thumbsup:
